scientific_limitations: Idealized all-or-none flower success threshold; homogeneous positive integer pollen packet size; independent Poisson arrivals; fixed mean delivered effective grains; no size-dependent arrival or compatibility, no variable packet size, no partial seed-set payoff.
title: An all-or-nothing pollen-packet law at fixed mean receipt
